steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: You can't forget... Your filthy hands, filthy past...

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Embrace your fear!
The monster drags its broken body forward, turning into smoke while reluctantly trying to grab McQueen.
McQueen just quietly watches the howling shadow, neither attacking nor dodging out of the way.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: What are you waiting for?!
Lisa pulls McQueen back in time, and her violet butterflies crush the shadow's remaining arm.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I'm not waiting for anything. I trust that you'll help me defeat them, Miss Lisa...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I didn't encounter any shadows before I met you. You were never lost. You had the whole thing planned from the beginning!

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: That's right. From the moment I saw you crushing the ads with your butterflies. I knew that with your determination, you could help me defeat the shadows.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Butterflies... Right, Miss Lisa became famous because of your work, <color=#fb9259>Butterfly</color>. To you, it is the most important symbolization of your artistic ideal, right?

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: You can no longer paint, but butterflies are still a part of your special power!

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Judy on the Blue Couch? Hah, haven't heard that name for a long time. Unlike you, my special power is to copy.
McQueen smiles and takes a few steps back, actively keeping a distance from Lisa.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Other than that, do you have nothing else to explain for yourself?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Why did you come to the art museum when you knew the place would stir up unpleasant memories?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Your special power to copy, you didn't want to see the exhibition but showed up in the staff tunnel, the forgery, your dream, and your past...

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: What exactly do you want?

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Isn't it too late to suspect me now?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: No, I want to help you.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Yes?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I trust my feelings. You tried to reveal the truth to me along the way. Your fear being here means you regret going astray. I think the painter who added her own touch to the forgery is still there.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I don't mind you using my power as long as it doesn't go against the heart of creation. I prefer to believe what I feel rather than what's shown on the surface.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Haha... Hahahaha...
Like she heard something hilarious, McQueen's burst of laughter echoes in the cold concrete-built space.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: They say that Lisa the critic is mean and aloof, but I find you rather innocent and adorable.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: You won't find any heart of creation left in me, but I can try to keep my promise and escort you out.
The letter openers spin back and forth nimbly between her fingers.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: The final layer of fear is the strong mutation from the <color=#fb9259>Gate of Hell</color>. Care to join me for this one?
